summary: Verified the offline-session-restore bug fix in Berber PWA. All 8 requested scenarios pass. When the app is launched offline with a previously authenticated session, AuthContext now: (a) reads cached user + token from localStorage without erasing them, (b) skips the /auth/me network call while offline and lands the user directly on their role home under /app, (c) always calls setLoading(false) in finally so the Splash dismisses within ~3s. Offline banner ('لا يوجد اتصال — وضع العرض فقط') renders correctly. Reconnect flow re-hits /auth/me silently and clears the banner. Regression tests (fresh guest online→/auth, fresh guest offline→/onboarding without crash, 401 bad-token real-logout→/auth with token cleared) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.jsx refresh() is now bulletproof: try/catch/finally with setLoading(false) in finally, offline branch never touches the network or removes the token, only 401/403 clears the session — this correctly separates 'no network' from 'auth revoked'. Solid.
cacheUser() is invoked on login/register/updateProfile so the cache stays fresh — good coverage.
api.js axios timeout=15000 prevents the previous infinite-hang scenario during offline network attempts — a necessary companion to the AuthContext fix.

Minor (out of scope for this fix): child pages like CustomerHome/AdminDashboard fire their own axios GETs on mount and throw uncaught Network Errors when offline. In dev mode this shows a red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay from react-dev-utils (does NOT appear in production build), but each page still renders behind it. Consider wrapping page-level fetches in try/catch or a shared useAsync hook so read-only offline mode is fully silent even in dev.

Consider persisting a lightweight 'last_role' hint alongside the user cache so RoleHome could pre-select the correct dashboard shell even before user hydrates from cache (currently fine because readCachedUser is synchronous, but nice-to-have for future skeleton loading).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Offline PWA testing sequence that works reliably: (1) goto BASE with online, wait 5s for Splash to self-dismiss, (2) if url is /onboarding click [data-testid=onboarding-skip], (3) auth form uses testids auth-phone-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-btn / auth-tab-login / auth-tab-register / role-customer-btn / auth-name-input (NOT login-phone/reg-phone), (4) after landing /app do wait_for_load_state('networkidle') THEN await page.context.set_offline(True) THEN page.reload — this triggers the real fix path. (5) Do NOT clear localStorage between offline sub-tests. React dev overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors' may appear over the app when other pages' axios calls fail offline — it is a dev-only artifact; the actual app content (offline banner, /app URL, cache) is still there and works. Test via data-testids and URL, not visual overlays.
rca of the issue: Original bug: on offline boot, refresh() in AuthContext threw an unhandled AxiosError from api.get('/auth/me'), which never resolved because axios had no timeout, so setLoading(false) never fired → infinite splash. Fix: (a) short-circuit refresh() when navigator.onLine===false and hydrate from berber_user_cache, (b) wrap the whole refresh in try/catch/finally with setLoading(false) in finally, (c) distinguish 401/403 (real logout — clear token) from network/5xx (preserve token, fall back to cache), (d) add axios timeout=15000. Verified end-to-end via Playwright.
